project.name: treetracker-android
project.description: Grower-facing Android app for capturing trees as geotagged photos, managing grower accounts and wallets, and syncing captures to the Treetracker backend.

nodes.name: Tree Capture
nodes.summary: Covers the core field work of a grower. A grower runs the org-configured capture setup, opens a capture session, and photographs each tree after the GPS position converges. The grower then reviews and annotates the capture, and the app saves it offline. This domain also restores a capture that Android interrupted, and lets growers edit or delete saved trees before upload.

businessRules: The capture screen accepts a photo only after the location pin is complete. The screen waits up to 30 seconds for the pin. When the wait times out or no coordinate is available, the screen shows a bad GPS dialog.
GPS converges when the longitude and latitude standard deviations of a sliding window of GPS fixes are both below the configured thresholds.
When the convergence wait times out, the capture uses the last converged window of the session. When no window converged, the capture uses the current window.
Each tree belongs to the current session. A session starts when the setup flow of the organization ends. The session ends when the grower leaves capture for the dashboard or for user select.
Each tree records the absolute step count and the delta step count as attributes. When the device gives a rotation matrix snapshot, the tree also records the snapshot.
When the organization turns on the force note feature for image review, Next opens the note dialog while the note is blank.
The app keeps the unsaved tree as JSON in preferences until it saves or discards the tree. Thus image review and tree height can show the tree again after Android kills the app process.
Tree Edit lets the grower change the note or delete the tree only while the tree is not uploaded. A deletion needs a confirmation. A deletion also removes the local photo.
In the debug, dev and beta builds, the capture screen has a button that creates fake trees. The fake trees go into the normal upload queue.
crossDomainInteractions: Runs the setup flow, the capture flow and the step features of the current organization (Organization & Wallet Selection).
Uses the growers of Grower Onboarding & Identity. User select can open sign-up to add a grower during capture setup.
Data Sync & Upload uploads the trees, sessions and GPS track points that capture saves.
The Track button on the dashboard opens user select to start capture setup (Dashboard, Map & App Settings).
Settings opens Tree Edit (Dashboard, Map & App Settings).

nodes.name: Start Capture Session
nodes.summary: Takes a grower from the Track button through the org-configured setup steps to an open capture session with sensors and GPS running.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Track button on the dashboard (UserSelectRoute)

nodes.name: Open Capture Setup Scope
nodes.summary: Opens the Koin scope that holds the setup data for one setup run and starts GPS updates; when capture ended an earlier setup, it reopens the scope and clears the old grower selection.

nodes.name: Select Planting Grower
nodes.summary: Stores the chosen grower in preferences and in the setup scope as the user who plants the trees of this session.

nodes.name: Walk Org-Configured Setup Steps
nodes.summary: Moves to the next setup step of the current org, drops a double-tapped Next, and re-syncs the step index with the back stack first.

nodes.name: Add Optional Session Note
nodes.summary: Writes the typed session note into the setup scope and the screen state, and ignores input once the setup is lost.

nodes.name: Finish Setup and Open Capture
nodes.summary: At the last setup step it enables the step counter and orientation sensor, starts the session and GPS, and opens tree capture with the grower photo.

nodes.name: Create Session Record
nodes.summary: Ends any running session, then inserts a session row with a new UUID, the grower wallet as both origin and destination wallet, the organization name from setup (or the current org name), the note and the latest device config. It makes the session current in memory and in preferences.

nodes.name: Capture Tree Photo with Converged GPS
nodes.summary: Pins a converged GPS location for a new tree, accepts the photo only when a coordinate is known, and builds the tree record with sensor attributes.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Capture button on the tree capture screen (TreeCaptureRoute)

nodes.name: Open Capture Flow Scope
nodes.summary: Opens the Koin scope of one capture flow before it builds the capture view model, so the tree capturer and flow controller start fresh.

nodes.name: Pin Tree Location
nodes.summary: Turns on tree capture mode with a new tree UUID, suspends until the GPS converges or times out, and keeps the convergence when a coordinate is available.

nodes.name: Judge GPS Convergence
nodes.summary: In tree capture mode, slides the window of recent fixes, recomputes the convergence, publishes the progress percentage, and marks the status CONVERGED when both deviations are under the thresholds.

nodes.name: Compute Convergence Statistics
nodes.summary: Computes the mean, variance and standard deviation of longitude and latitude over the window, with an incremental update when one fix replaces another.

nodes.name: Wait for Convergence or Timeout
nodes.summary: Polls the convergence status until it is CONVERGED or the configured timeout passes, and then sets the status to TIMED_OUT.

nodes.name: Accept Photo after Location Pin
nodes.summary: Waits up to 30 seconds for the pin; with a location it hands the photo to the tree capturer and moves the capture flow forward, otherwise it shows the bad-GPS dialog.

nodes.name: Build Tree Record
nodes.summary: Creates the Tree from the pinned UUID, the current session, the photo path and the mean coordinates, adds step counts and the rotation matrix, and keeps it in the pending store.

nodes.name: Review, Annotate and Save Tree
nodes.summary: Walks the org-configured capture steps after the photo, such as image review with a note and tree height, then saves the tree and loops back to capture; leaving capture ends the session.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Org capture flow steps after the photo (TreeImageReviewRoute, TreeHeightScreenRoute)

nodes.name: Check Org Force-Note Feature
nodes.summary: Asks the feature resolver whether the current org sets forceNote on the image review step.

nodes.name: Review Photo and Add Note
nodes.summary: Keeps the typed note as a draft and saves it on the current tree when the grower confirms the note dialog. On Next it opens the note dialog instead of moving on when the org requires a note and the draft is blank.

nodes.name: Record Tree Height Colour
nodes.summary: Saves the index of the chosen height colour as the tree colour attribute and marks that colour as selected.

nodes.name: Advance Capture Flow
nodes.summary: Moves to the next org capture step; past the last step it resets the index, saves the tree, and pops back to the capture screen for the next tree.

nodes.name: Save Tree and Clear Pending Capture
nodes.summary: Saves the current tree through CreateTreeUseCase, then clears the in-memory tree and the pending store; on failure it keeps the tree.

nodes.name: Persist Tree Row
nodes.summary: Maps the Tree to a TreeEntity with session, photo, note, coordinates, creation time and attributes, inserts it, and logs a tree planted analytics event.

nodes.name: End Session on Leaving Capture
nodes.summary: Discards the pending tree, closes the capture and setup scopes, ends the session, stops the sensors and GPS, and turns off tree capture mode.

nodes.name: Close Session Row
nodes.summary: Sets the end time on the current session row, clears the current session id in memory and in preferences, refreshes the stored count of trees to sync, and clears the session keys of the crash report data.

nodes.name: Restore Interrupted Capture
nodes.summary: Brings a capture setup step or a capture step back after Android kills the app: it reloads the kept tree and setup grower, resumes the interrupted session, or sends the grower to the dashboard when nothing can be restored.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Navigation 3 restores a setup or capture screen after process death

nodes.name: Keep Unsaved Capture
nodes.summary: Writes the unsaved tree as JSON under a preference key, and reads it back, clearing data that cannot be decoded.

nodes.name: Rebuild Capture Flow Scope
nodes.summary: Reopens the capture flow scope, restores the kept tree, and asks the flow controller to resume at the restored route; it drops the tree when that fails.

nodes.name: Resume Capture Step and Sensors
nodes.summary: Points the flow at the restored route, checks that the kept tree belongs to the interrupted session, and restarts the step counter, orientation sensor and GPS.

nodes.name: Resume Interrupted Session
nodes.summary: Makes the session id saved in preferences current again, and reports an interruption when memory has no session but preferences still hold one.

nodes.name: Leave When the Tree Is Lost
nodes.summary: Sends the grower to the dashboard when image review was restored but the tree could not be restored.

nodes.name: Restore Setup Step
nodes.summary: Reopens a closed setup scope for a restored setup screen and reloads the setup grower from the saved id; with no grower it closes the scope.

nodes.name: Leave Lost Setup
nodes.summary: Returns a setup screen to the dashboard when its setup state could not be restored.

nodes.name: Edit Saved Trees
nodes.summary: Lets a grower open the trees captured under a wallet, change the note of a tree, or delete a tree and its photo while the tree is not uploaded.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Settings, Edit trees entry (TreeEditUserSelectRoute)

nodes.name: Choose Grower
nodes.summary: Reuses the shared user picker in settings mode and opens the tree list for the wallet and name of the chosen grower.

nodes.name: List Trees of the Wallet
nodes.summary: Collects from Room the trees of every session whose origin wallet is the grower wallet, and keeps the selected tree in step with the refreshed list.

nodes.name: Load Tree Detail
nodes.summary: Loads the selected tree by id and fills the note editor with its current note.

nodes.name: Allow Edits Only Before Upload
nodes.summary: Disables the note editor and hides the save and delete buttons when the tree is already uploaded.

nodes.name: Save Tree Note
nodes.summary: Writes the edited note to the tree row and shows a saved snackbar.

nodes.name: Confirm Tree Deletion
nodes.summary: Shows a confirmation dialog before the tree is deleted.

nodes.name: Delete Tree and Photo
nodes.summary: Deletes the local photo file and the tree row, refreshes the count of trees to sync, and goes back.

nodes.name: Refresh Pending Upload Count
nodes.summary: Adds the legacy and current tree rows that still have no photo URL and stores the total in preferences.

nodes.name: Grower Onboarding & Identity
nodes.summary: Covers how grower accounts start and change on the device. It handles the first launch with permissions and a language choice, and sign-up with a phone or email wallet, names, and a selfie. It also covers profile viewing, editing and deletion; the first account on a device becomes the power user.

businessRules: The wallet of a grower is the phone number or the email that the grower enters at sign-up. When that wallet already exists on the device, sign-up offers the existing grower instead of a new account.
Sign-up accepts an email wallet when the text contains '@'. Sign-up does no other email check.
Sign-up accepts a phone wallet of 7 to 15 digits with no other characters.
The first name and the last name must pass name validation before the selfie step. A valid name has 2 to 50 letters, spaces, hyphens or apostrophes.
The app creates the account only after the selfie returns a photo path.
When the device has no power user, the next grower from sign-up becomes the power user. The app never sets a second power user.
A profile edit saves only the names and the photo. The wallet, the phone and the email stay as registered. The names must pass name validation before the save.
A new profile photo clears the photo URL. Each profile edit resets the uploaded flag, so the registration uploads again.
A profile deletion removes the local account. It also queues a deletion request message to the admin. When the deleted account is the power user, the app returns to sign-up.
The Delete account entry of Settings shows only in the debug and dev builds.
The app supports three languages: English, Swahili and Portuguese.
crossDomainInteractions: A grower that sign-up creates during capture setup continues the setup flow (Tree Capture).
Data Sync & Upload uploads new and edited growers as wallet registrations with their photos.
A profile deletion queues a message to the admin. Then it starts a message sync (Grower Messaging).
The splash bootstrap also resolves the linked organization (Organization & Wallet Selection).

nodes.name: First Launch Bootstrap
nodes.summary: Asks for runtime permissions, prepares device and org state, and sends a device without a power user to the language picker and sign-up, or a set-up device to the dashboard.

domainMeta.entryPoint: App launch (SplashRoute)

nodes.name: Build Runtime Permission Set
nodes.summary: Collects the camera and location permissions, plus activity recognition on Android 10 and later and notifications on Android 13 and later, for the launch request.

nodes.name: Bootstrap Device State
nodes.summary: Saves the latest device config, applies an org link, syncs messages when online, tags the power user wallet for crash reports, and refreshes the stored count of trees to sync when a session was interrupted or no count is stored yet.

nodes.name: Route First Run
nodes.summary: When no power user exists, it starts GPS for sign-up (only if a location permission was granted) and opens the language picker; otherwise it opens the dashboard.

nodes.name: Pick Language and Continue
nodes.summary: Confirms the selected language and, on a first run, goes on to sign-up.

nodes.name: Grower Sign-Up
nodes.summary: Registers a grower with a phone or email wallet, first and last names, and a selfie, and makes the first account on the device its power user.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Sign-up flow (SignupFlowRoute) after the language picker, or the add button of the user picker

nodes.name: Enter Phone or Email Wallet
nodes.summary: Stores the typed email in lower case, or the typed phone number, and clears the other field. It also sets the credential flag that enables Next: for an email it only checks that the text contains '@'; for a phone it uses the shared phone rule Validation.isValidPhoneNumber, which accepts 7 to 15 digits and nothing else.

nodes.name: Detect Existing Wallet
nodes.summary: Looks up the entered wallet; it shows the existing user when found, or moves on to the name step.

nodes.name: Filter and Check Names
nodes.summary: Filters each typed first or last name to letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes (at most 50 characters), checks the result with the shared name rule ValidationUtils.validateName, and stores the filtered name with its rule error.

nodes.name: Gate Selfie on Valid Names
nodes.summary: Checks that both names pass the shared name rule: not blank, 2 to 50 characters, and only letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes. The name screen enables its Next arrow, which launches the selfie camera, only when this check passes.

nodes.name: Take Selfie
nodes.summary: In a separate camera activity, shows the front camera preview and the selfie tutorial, and opens image review with the captured photo; the tutorial opens at first only when the device has no power user.

nodes.name: Approve Selfie
nodes.summary: Returns the approved photo path to sign-up, or goes back to the selfie screen on reject.

nodes.name: Create Grower Account
nodes.summary: Saves the new user with the names, wallet and selfie, and makes the user the power user when none exists.

nodes.name: Store User Row
nodes.summary: Inserts a user row with the current location, time, a random UUID and the photo path, and logs a user created analytics event.

nodes.name: Route after Sign-Up
nodes.summary: Opens the dashboard for a new power user; otherwise it puts the user in the setup scope and continues capture setup.

nodes.name: Edit Grower Profile
nodes.summary: Lets a grower open a profile from Settings, change the names or photo, and save the change so the registration uploads again.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Settings, Profile entry (ProfileSelectRoute)

nodes.name: Pick Grower Profile
nodes.summary: Reuses the shared user picker and opens the profile of the chosen grower.

nodes.name: Show Profile
nodes.summary: Builds the profile view model for the grower and registers a camera launcher for a new photo.

nodes.name: Edit Profile Fields
nodes.summary: Copies the selected user with the changed names, wallet text and photo into the screen state.

nodes.name: Save Profile
nodes.summary: Writes the selected user to the database on the IO dispatcher.

nodes.name: Update User Row for Upload
nodes.summary: Copies the names and photo onto the stored row; the wallet, phone and email stay as registered, so an edited wallet is not saved. It clears the photo URL when the photo changed and resets the uploaded flag, so the registration uploads again.

nodes.name: Delete Grower Profile
nodes.summary: Deletes a grower account from the device after a confirmation and asks the admin, through a message, to delete the account data.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Settings, Delete account entry (DeleteProfileRoute), debug builds only

nodes.name: Confirm Profile to Delete
nodes.summary: Shows the user picker, a confirmation dialog for the chosen user, and the result after deletion.

nodes.name: Delete Local Account
nodes.summary: Deletes the account rows for the wallet and reports whether a row was removed.

nodes.name: Queue Deletion Request to Admin
nodes.summary: Marks the account as deleted locally, saves a deletion request message to the admin, and tries a message sync without crashing when offline.

nodes.name: Organization & Wallet Selection
nodes.summary: Decides which organization the device works for and how its capture runs. An org link from a deep link or the Play install referrer adds the org with the setup and capture steps from Firebase Remote Config. During capture setup the grower can pick or type a destination wallet, which the session row does not use, and enter the organization name that the session row stores.

businessRules: The default Greenstand organization always exists. Its setup flow is user select and then add organization. Its capture flow is capture and then image review.

When the app starts without an organization deep link, it reads the Play install referrer. It reads the referrer at each start until the answer is available or unsupported. Then it marks the referrer as consumed.

The app fetches the Remote Config of a linked organization for up to 10 seconds. With a valid config, the app adds the organization with the steps of that config. Without a valid config, the app adds a minimal organization with user select as its only setup step. In both cases, the app makes it the current organization.
Before the app stores an organization from Remote Config, it drops the routes that the route registry does not know.
The developer options overrides apply to the current organization only in the debug and dev builds. Their master switch must also be on.
The beta build shows the overrides in developer options. The beta build does not apply them.
Wallet select appears only when the setup flow of the organization lists it. Wallet select and add wallet write the destination wallet into the capture setup.
The session row takes its destination wallet from the wallet of the session grower. The session row does not use the wallet from wallet select or the wallet ID of the organization.
The session row stores the organization name from the add organization step. When the setup flow has no add organization step, the session row stores the name of the current organization.
The organization picker screen has a route. No screen opens it, because its dashboard button is commented out.
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies the setup flow, the capture flow and the step features that Tree Capture runs.
Writes the organization name into the capture setup of Tree Capture. The session row stores that name.
Writes the destination wallet into the capture setup of Tree Capture. Tree Capture does not read that wallet.
The splash bootstrap of Grower Onboarding & Identity resolves the linked organization.
Developer options in Dashboard, Map & App Settings edit the organization overrides.

nodes.name: Join Organization from Org Link
nodes.summary: Reads an org id and name from a deep link or the Play install referrer, fetches the org config, and stores and selects the org with its configured flows.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Deep link app://mobile.treetracker.org/org?id=...&name=..., or the Play install referrer at first launch

nodes.name: Parse Org Deep Link
nodes.summary: Turns a matching launch intent URI into a splash route that carries the org id and name.

nodes.name: Read Install Referrer
nodes.summary: Fetches the Play install referrer with a 3 second timeout, parses org_id and org_name, and marks the referrer consumed after a definite answer (available or unsupported); an unavailable referrer is tried again at the next launch.

nodes.name: Resolve Linked Org
nodes.summary: Prefers the deep link org and falls back to the install referrer org.

nodes.name: Fetch Org Config
nodes.summary: Fetches and activates Firebase Remote Config with a 10 second timeout and reads the org_<orgId> key; it returns null on a timeout, an error or a blank value.

nodes.name: Store Org with Configured Flows
nodes.summary: Parses the wallet id, version, setup flow and capture flow from the config, stores the org, and selects it; a parse error falls back to a minimal org.

nodes.name: Drop Unknown Routes
nodes.summary: Removes the flow routes that the route registry does not recognize and logs them.

nodes.name: Add Minimal Org
nodes.summary: Stores and selects an org with only an id and a name, with user select as setup and capture then image review as the capture flow.

nodes.name: Make Org Current
nodes.summary: Saves the new current org id in preferences and loads that org, with the default org as the fallback.

nodes.name: Apply Org Flow Configuration
nodes.summary: Turns the stored org into the ordered setup and capture steps and the per-step features that the capture flows run.

domainMeta.entryPoint: App start (Root gate) and each new capture setup or capture flow scope

nodes.name: Load Current Org
nodes.summary: Inserts the default org, loads the stored current org id, falls back to the default org, and repairs a missing org after a restore.

nodes.name: Decode Flow Steps
nodes.summary: Decodes the setup and capture flow JSON of the org row into ordered Destination lists.

nodes.name: Overlay Debug Overrides
nodes.summary: Returns the current org with the dev options overrides applied on top; the overrides are active only in debug builds with their master switch on.

nodes.name: Scope Flow Controllers
nodes.summary: Creates one setup data holder and setup flow controller per setup scope, and one flow controller and tree capturer per capture scope, from the current org flows.

nodes.name: Resolve Route Strings
nodes.summary: Maps org route strings and their aliases to typed navigation keys and checks whether a route is known.

nodes.name: Resolve Capture Step Features
nodes.summary: Answers whether a capture flow step of the current org, with dev options overrides applied, lists a feature; image review asks it for forceNote, the only feature defined.

nodes.name: Select Destination Wallet
nodes.summary: In an org setup flow that lists wallet select, the grower picks the wallet of a grower on the device or types a new wallet name. The choice goes only into the setup data and the crash report data: the session row that setup creates takes the planting grower's wallet as its destination wallet.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Wallet select step of the org setup flow (WalletSelectRoute), and its add wallet screen

nodes.name: Load Wallet Options
nodes.summary: Restores the setup grower when needed and lists that grower first, followed by the other growers on the device.

nodes.name: Pick Grower Wallet
nodes.summary: Looks up the chosen grower and writes that grower's wallet into the setup data as the destination wallet; the setter also puts it in the crash report data.

nodes.name: Type New Wallet Name
nodes.summary: Writes the typed wallet name into the setup data as the destination wallet; the setter also puts it in the crash report data.

nodes.name: Continue from Wallet Select
nodes.summary: Leaves a lost setup, drops the second tap of a double tap, and maps the screen actions to setup navigation; Next continues setup when the setup grower is known, with or without a picked wallet.

nodes.name: Set Session Destination Wallet
nodes.summary: When setup ends, the new session row takes the planting grower's wallet as its destination wallet. The user wallet is a non-null field, so the org wallet fallback never applies, and no code reads the wallet picked or typed in this flow.

nodes.name: Enter Session Organization
nodes.summary: In the add org setup step, the grower types an organization name or reuses the previous one, and the session row records it.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Add org step of the org setup flow (AddOrgRoute)

nodes.name: Prefill Org Name
nodes.summary: Restores the setup grower when needed, prefills the field and the setup data with the current org name unless it is blank or the default Greenstand org, and offers the previously used org name for autofill.

nodes.name: Type or Autofill Org Name
nodes.summary: Writes each typed name into the setup data; autofill puts the previous org name into the field. On Next (SetDefaultOrg) it writes the field into the setup data and saves a non-blank name as the previous org name for later sessions.

nodes.name: Continue from Add Org
nodes.summary: Leaves a lost setup, drops the second tap of a double tap, and blocks Back and Next while the setup is restoring or lost; Next saves the org name and moves to the next setup step.

nodes.name: Hold Org Name
nodes.summary: Keeps the organization name in the setup data and tags it for crash reports.

nodes.name: Record Org on Session
nodes.summary: Stores the entered organization name on the new session row, with the current org name as the fallback.

nodes.name: Data Sync & Upload
nodes.summary: Moves the offline data from the device to the backend when the grower taps upload. A foreground WorkManager job syncs messages, device config, growers, sessions, legacy trees, current trees and GPS tracks in a fixed order. Photos go to object storage first, then JSON bundles carry their URLs; the app flags uploaded rows and deletes the local photos.

businessRules: The sync runs as unique work. A tap on Upload while the sync runs cancels the sync.
When no tree waits for upload, a tap on Upload shows a message and does not start the sync. The debug and dev builds start the sync anyway.
The upload order is fixed: messages, device configurations, growers, sessions, legacy trees, trees, and then locations.
Trees upload in windows of 50. In each window, the photos without a URL upload first. A window fails when a photo upload returns no URL.
When a tree that the pass tried is still not uploaded, the tree step fails. The next sync tries the remaining trees again.
The app deletes the local tree photos after their bundle uploads.
A grower registration needs a photo URL. When a grower photo does not upload, the grower step fails and the sync stops.
GPS track points upload in groups by session UUID. The app purges the points after the upload.
The app saves a new device configuration row when the app version, the app build, the OS release or the SDK level differs from the latest row.
A sync step that throws an error stops the sync. The job then fails. The location step catches its own errors. Thus a failed track upload keeps the points for the next sync.
The V2 captures bundle sends the step counts, the rotation matrix and the extra attributes as null. Thus the sensor attributes that capture records stay on the device.
crossDomainInteractions: Uploads the trees, sessions and GPS track points that Tree Capture saves.
Uploads the grower registrations and the grower photos of Grower Onboarding & Identity.
Runs the message sync of Grower Messaging as its first step.
The dashboard of Dashboard, Map & App Settings starts and cancels the job. The dashboard shows the tree counts and the result of the job.

nodes.name: Run Data Sync
nodes.summary: Starts or cancels the sync job from the dashboard, runs every upload step in order in a foreground job, and reports progress and the result.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Upload button on the dashboard (DashboardAction.Sync)

nodes.name: Start or Cancel Sync
nodes.summary: When idle it starts the sync, except in non-debug builds with no trees left, where it shows a nothing-to-sync snackbar; when a sync runs it cancels the unique work. It logs each tap for analytics.

nodes.name: Enqueue Unique Sync Work
nodes.summary: Enqueues an expedited one-time sync request with linear backoff as unique work, and keeps a sync that is already queued.

nodes.name: Run Foreground Sync Job
nodes.summary: Promotes the work to a foreground job, runs the sync use case, and polls the pending photo count every 750 ms for the notification.

nodes.name: Update Sync Notification
nodes.summary: Reposts the sync notification with a progress bar and the uploaded count.

nodes.name: Sync in Fixed Order
nodes.summary: Gets the Firebase installation id (empty on error) and runs message sync, device config, users, sessions, legacy trees, trees and locations in that order. The first step that throws stops the sync and makes it return false; the location step catches its own errors, so a failed track upload does not fail the sync.

nodes.name: Track Sync Step
nodes.summary: Wraps one sync action in start, complete and fail calls on the progress tracker (a no-op tracker outside debug builds) and rethrows a failure.

nodes.name: Report Sync Result
nodes.summary: Maps the state of the unique sync work to snackbar messages and the syncing flag on the dashboard.

nodes.name: Upload Trees and Photos
nodes.summary: Uploads the current trees in passes and windows: photos to the images bucket first, then a V2 captures bundle, then it deletes the local photos.

domainMeta.entryPoint: TREES step of the sync job

nodes.name: Run Tree Upload Passes
nodes.summary: Uploads the pending trees in passes, updates the step progress, and fails the step when an attempted tree is still pending.

nodes.name: Process Trees in Windows of 50
nodes.summary: Splits the tree ids into windows of 50 and, for each window, uploads the photos, uploads the captures bundle, deletes the local photos and clears their paths; a failed window is logged and the next window runs.

nodes.name: Upload Missing Tree Photos
nodes.summary: Uploads in parallel the photos of trees without a URL, fails the window when no URL comes back, and saves each URL.

nodes.name: Put Photo in Object Storage
nodes.summary: Uploads the image file to the images bucket under a key with a timestamp, the coordinates and a random UUID, and returns the URL.

nodes.name: Upload V2 Captures Bundle
nodes.summary: Builds a capture request per tree with its session UUID, coordinates, note, photo URL and creation time (step counts, rotation matrix and extra attributes are sent as null), stores the bundle id on the trees, uploads the V2 bundle, and marks the trees uploaded.

nodes.name: Write Bundle to Object Storage
nodes.summary: Writes the JSON bundle as UTF-8 bytes to the batch uploads bucket under a key with a timestamp, a random UUID and the bundle id.

nodes.name: Delete Uploaded Tree Photos
nodes.summary: Deletes each local photo file of the uploaded trees that still exists on disk.

nodes.name: Upload Device Config, Growers and Sessions
nodes.summary: Uploads the device config rows, the grower photos and wallet registrations, and the session metadata as V2 bundles before the trees upload.

domainMeta.entryPoint: DEVICE_CONFIG, USERS and SESSIONS steps of the sync job

nodes.name: Snapshot Device Config
nodes.summary: At app launch (splash bootstrap), saves a new device config row with the app version and build and the OS release and SDK level when none exists or the latest one no longer matches.

nodes.name: Upload Device Config Bundle
nodes.summary: Maps the pending device configs to requests, uploads them as a V2 bundle, and marks them uploaded.

nodes.name: Upload Grower Photos
nodes.summary: Uploads in parallel the profile photos of pending users without a URL and stores each URL on the user row.

nodes.name: Upload Wallet Registrations
nodes.summary: Converts the pending users into wallet registration requests, uploads them as a V2 bundle, and marks them uploaded.

nodes.name: Upload Session Bundle
nodes.summary: Builds a request per pending session with its UUID, origin user, destination wallet, organization and device config UUID, stores the bundle id, uploads the V2 bundle, and marks the sessions uploaded. It has no empty check, so a sync with no pending session still uploads a bundle with an empty session list.

nodes.name: Record and Upload GPS Tracks
nodes.summary: Records each GPS fix during a session as a track point, then uploads the points not yet uploaded, grouped by session, as a tracks bundle and purges them. An upload error is logged and the points stay for the next sync; the sync job does not fail.

domainMeta.entryPoint: LOCATIONS step of the sync job; recording runs on each GPS fix during a session

nodes.name: Record Track Point
nodes.summary: For each GPS fix while a session is current, stores the session id, coordinates, accuracy, tree UUID, convergence status and time as JSON in a location row.

nodes.name: Group Points by Session
nodes.summary: Loads the location rows not yet uploaded, groups them by session, and decodes each into a location request.

nodes.name: Build Tracks Requests
nodes.summary: Creates one tracks request per session with the session UUID and its location list.

nodes.name: Upload Tracks Bundle
nodes.summary: Encodes the tracks as a V2 bundle and uploads it to object storage under its MD5 hash with a tracks suffix; with no pending points it still uploads an empty tracks bundle.

nodes.name: Mark Uploaded and Purge
nodes.summary: Marks the uploaded location rows and deletes the uploaded rows.

nodes.name: Upload Legacy V1 Captures
nodes.summary: Uploads the data that remains in the legacy V1 schema: planter check-in photos, planter registrations and legacy tree captures as V1 bundles.

domainMeta.entryPoint: USERS and LEGACY_TREES steps of the sync job

nodes.name: Upload Legacy Check-In Photos
nodes.summary: Uploads in parallel each pending planter check-in photo without a URL and saves the returned URL.

nodes.name: Upload Legacy Planter Registrations
nodes.summary: Builds V1 registration requests for pending planters with their earliest check-in photo and uploads them.

nodes.name: Upload Legacy Tree Photos
nodes.summary: Uploads in parallel the photos of legacy tree captures without a URL and saves each URL.

nodes.name: Build V1 Tree Requests
nodes.summary: Joins a legacy capture with its check-in and planter info and builds a V1 tree request with its attributes.

nodes.name: Upload V1 Tree Bundle
nodes.summary: Uploads the V1 tree requests as a bundle named by its MD5 hash and marks the captures uploaded.

nodes.name: Delete Uploaded Check-In Photos
nodes.summary: Deletes the local photo files of check-ins that already have a remote URL and clears their local paths.

nodes.name: Grower Messaging
nodes.summary: Gives each grower an inbox of direct messages, announcements and surveys from the messaging endpoint of the backend API, stored on the device per wallet. Growers chat, read announcements and answer surveys. Outgoing messages and survey answers queue on the device and upload as bundles at the end of each message sync.

businessRules: Message sync fetches the messages of each grower wallet on the device. For each wallet, it fetches only the messages after the newest stored message.
Message sync treats a 404 answer as a wallet with no messages. An error for one wallet does not stop the fetch for the other wallets.
Message sync ignores the survey responses that come from the server.
The inbox shows the newest direct message from each other sender, the surveys that are not complete, and all announcements. The inbox sorts them by compose time, newest first.
When the grower opens a chat, an announcement or a survey, the app marks it as read.
When the grower answers the last survey question, the app saves all answers as one response linked to the survey. Then the app marks the survey complete.
After the fetch, message sync uploads the queued outgoing messages and survey responses. They upload in groups of 50 as V2 message bundles.
The splash and the dashboard Messages button sync messages only when the internet check succeeds.
crossDomainInteractions: Unread badges show in the grower pickers of profile select and account deletion (Grower Onboarding & Identity).
Unread badges also show in user select of capture setup (Tree Capture) and on the dashboard Messages button (Dashboard, Map & App Settings).
The sync job of Data Sync & Upload runs message sync as its first step.
A profile deletion in Grower Onboarding & Identity queues a message to the admin.

nodes.name: Sync Messages
nodes.summary: Downloads new messages, surveys and questions for every local wallet and uploads the queued outgoing messages and survey answers.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Messages button on the dashboard, the splash bootstrap, and the first step of the sync job

nodes.name: Check Internet before Sync
nodes.summary: Syncs messages from the dashboard only when the internet check succeeds.

nodes.name: Sync Each Local Wallet
nodes.summary: Fetches new server messages for the wallet of each local user; it skips a wallet that answers HTTP 404 (no messages yet) and logs other errors, then uploads the outgoing messages.

nodes.name: Fetch Message Pages
nodes.summary: Fetches the first page of 100 messages since the newest stored message of the wallet, then the other pages in parallel.

nodes.name: Call Messaging Endpoint
nodes.summary: Calls the messaging endpoint of the backend API with the handle, since, offset and limit parameters.

nodes.name: Store Messages, Surveys and Questions
nodes.summary: Converts each server message to a message row, ignores survey responses, and stores the survey and its questions.

nodes.name: Upload Outgoing Messages
nodes.summary: Reads the messages flagged for upload, uploads them in groups of 50 as V2 message bundles, and marks them uploaded.

nodes.name: Browse Grower Inbox
nodes.summary: Lets a grower pick a profile with unread badges and see an inbox of chats, open surveys and announcements.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Messages button on the dashboard (MessagesUserSelectRoute)

nodes.name: Pick Grower
nodes.summary: Shows the shared user picker in messaging colors with unread badges and opens the inbox of the chosen grower.

nodes.name: Flag Unread Messages
nodes.summary: Reports whether a wallet has at least one unread message, for the badge on the grower card.

nodes.name: Collect Wallet Messages
nodes.summary: Streams all messages of a wallet and converts each row to its message type.

nodes.name: Build Inbox List
nodes.summary: Keeps the newest direct message per external sender, the surveys that are not complete and all announcements, sorted by compose time.

nodes.name: Open Selected Message
nodes.summary: Opens the chat, survey or announcement screen for the selected inbox item.

nodes.name: Direct Message Chat
nodes.summary: Shows the conversation between a grower and one other party, marks it read, and queues the messages the grower sends.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Direct message item in the inbox (chat route)

nodes.name: Load Chat Thread
nodes.summary: Loads the current grower, collects the conversation with the other party, and marks unread messages read.

nodes.name: Stream Direct Messages
nodes.summary: Streams the direct messages between the wallet and the other party, newest first.

nodes.name: Send Draft Message
nodes.summary: Updates the draft text, or saves the draft as a new message from the grower wallet and clears it.

nodes.name: Queue Outgoing Message
nodes.summary: Stores the new message with a random UUID and the current time, flagged for upload and already read.

nodes.name: Read Announcement
nodes.summary: Shows one announcement with its sender, title, body and optional link, and marks it read.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Announcement item in the inbox (announcement route)

nodes.name: Load Announcement
nodes.summary: Loads the announcement, fills the sender, title, body and link, and marks the message read.

nodes.name: Show Announcement Content
nodes.summary: Shows the title, the body and an underlined link in a rounded card.

nodes.name: Open Announcement Link
nodes.summary: Starts a view intent so that the link opens in a browser or another app.

nodes.name: Answer Survey
nodes.summary: Takes a grower through the questions of a survey one at a time and saves the answers as a survey response for upload.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Survey item in the inbox (survey route)

nodes.name: Load Survey
nodes.summary: Loads the survey message and the grower photo, shows the first question, and marks the message read.

nodes.name: Select Answer
nodes.summary: Stores the chosen answer for the current question and mirrors it into the screen state.

nodes.name: Next Question or Submit
nodes.summary: Moves to the next question, or on the last question maps the answers to choice text, saves them, and closes the survey.

nodes.name: Save Survey Response
nodes.summary: Stores a survey response message linked to the same survey, flagged for upload, and marks the original survey complete.

nodes.name: Dashboard, Map & App Settings
nodes.summary: The home dashboard shows the synced and pending tree counts, an upload gauge, and the buttons for upload, messages and tracking. Settings opens profiles, tree editing, the privacy policy, and in some builds the tree map, logout and account deletion. The top bar changes the app language, and debug and beta builds offer developer options.

businessRules: The synced count and the pending count each add legacy trees and current trees. A tree counts as synced when its photo has a URL.
When 2000 or more trees wait for upload, the Track button first shows an upload reminder.
The dashboard stops GPS updates when it opens.
The Map entry of Settings shows only in the debug, dev and beta builds.
The map shows the trees of the current tree table, not legacy trees. The map also shows up to 5000 of the newest GPS points from sessions that have trees.
The Logout and Delete account entries of Settings show only in the debug and dev builds.
Logout removes the power user flag and returns the app to sign-up.
A long press on the top bar logo opens developer options in the debug, dev and beta builds. The convergence parameters refresh when developer options close.
The sync and sensor overlays show only in the debug and dev builds.
The dashboard computes whether more than one organization exists. No screen uses that value, because the organization button of the dashboard is commented out.
crossDomainInteractions: The Upload button starts and cancels the sync job of Data Sync & Upload.
The Track button opens user select to start capture setup (Tree Capture).
Settings opens Tree Edit (Tree Capture).
The Messages button syncs messages and opens the grower picker of the inbox (Grower Messaging).
Settings opens profile editing, account deletion and logout (Grower Onboarding & Identity).
Developer options override the steps, the features and the wallet ID of the current organization (Organization & Wallet Selection).

nodes.name: View Dashboard
nodes.summary: Shows the tree counts and upload gauge, the unread message badge, and routes the dashboard buttons to upload, messages, settings and tracking.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Dashboard after the splash or sign-up (DashboardRoute)

nodes.name: Observe Tree Counts
nodes.summary: Combines four Room flows of uploaded and pending legacy and current tree photos into synced and remaining counts, and sets the upload reminder at 2000 trees.

nodes.name: Check Unread Messages and Org Count
nodes.summary: Checks whether unread messages wait and publishes the unread badge flag. It also computes whether more than one org exists, but no live UI reads that flag, because the dashboard org button is commented out.

nodes.name: Draw Upload Stats
nodes.summary: Pairs the upload progress gauge and the count of trees waiting with the round upload button.

nodes.name: Route Dashboard Buttons
nodes.summary: Maps the buttons to sync, message sync and the inbox, settings, and capture setup, with the upload reminder dialog before tracking.

nodes.name: View Tree Map
nodes.summary: Shows each tree of the current schema as a map marker, with the GPS points of its session that are still on the device, and a card carousel of the trees.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Settings, Map entry (MapRoute), debug and beta builds only

nodes.name: Load Markers and Session Paths
nodes.summary: Reads all tree rows of the current schema as markers and up to 5000 of the newest location rows of sessions that have trees; it decodes each location into a path point and skips rows it cannot decode.

nodes.name: Render Map Layers
nodes.summary: Draws the path points and tree markers as GeoJSON circle layers on a MapLibre map, highlights the selected marker and its session points, reports marker taps, and moves the camera to the selection or fits all markers.

nodes.name: Select Marker
nodes.summary: Stores the selected marker and its session, so the screen highlights the session path.

nodes.name: Browse Tree Cards
nodes.summary: Scrolls a row of tree cards so that the selected marker is centered.

nodes.name: Manage App Settings
nodes.summary: Lists the settings entries for the build type, opens their screens, shows the privacy policy, and logs out the power user.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Settings icon on the dashboard (SettingsRoute)

nodes.name: Load Power User
nodes.summary: Loads the power user of the device for the settings screen.

nodes.name: Show Build-Gated Entries
nodes.summary: Shows the map entry only in debug or beta builds, and the logout and delete account entries only in debug builds.

nodes.name: Route Settings Actions
nodes.summary: Updates the dialog flags and opens the profile, tree editing, map and account deletion screens; a confirmed logout opens sign-up.

nodes.name: Show Privacy Policy
nodes.summary: Shows the privacy policy text in a scrollable panel with a close button.

nodes.name: Clear Power-User Flag
nodes.summary: On logout it clears the power-user flag of the user; the same function sets the flag only when no power user exists.

nodes.name: Change App Language
nodes.summary: Lets the grower switch the app language from the top bar and applies the locale at once.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Language button in the top bar (LanguageRoute with isFromTopBar = true)

nodes.name: Open Language Picker
nodes.summary: Shows the stored language on the top bar button as its enum name (for example ENGLISH), or EN when none is stored, and opens the language picker from the top bar.

nodes.name: Select Language
nodes.summary: Keeps a tapped language in the screen state and applies it on confirm.

nodes.name: Store Language and Set Locale
nodes.summary: Commits the language tag to preferences and sets the application locales.

nodes.name: Return to Previous Screen
nodes.summary: Confirms the language and pops back when the picker was opened from the top bar.

nodes.name: Tune Developer Options
nodes.summary: Lets testers change stored config values such as GPS convergence thresholds and override the steps, features and wallet of the current org.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Long press on the top bar logo (DevOptionsRoute), debug and beta builds only

nodes.name: Open Developer Options
nodes.summary: Opens developer options on a long press of the top bar logo in debug and beta builds.

nodes.name: Route Option Edits
nodes.summary: Maps each action to a config update, back navigation, or a change of the stored org overrides.

nodes.name: Update Config Value
nodes.summary: Saves a changed config value and replaces it in the screen state.

nodes.name: Persist Typed Config Value
nodes.summary: Matches the value as boolean, integer or float and saves it under its config key.

nodes.name: Persist Org Overrides
nodes.summary: Applies a change to the org overrides, publishes the result, and saves it as JSON in preferences.

nodes.name: Refresh Convergence Settings
nodes.summary: When the developer options view model is cleared, rebuilds the GPS convergence settings from the stored timeout, sample count and deviation thresholds.

edges.description: Runs the org-configured setup and capture steps and reads per-step features such as forceNote.
Add org writes the organization name that the session row stores; wallet select writes a destination wallet into the setup scope that the session does not read.
Uses the grower picked in user select as the planting grower, and opens sign-up to add a grower in the middle of setup.
Saved trees, sessions and GPS track points become the upload queue of the sync job.
New and edited growers upload as wallet registrations with their profile photos.
A profile deletion queues a deletion request message to the admin and syncs messages.
The first-launch bootstrap resolves an org link before it routes the first run.
The sync job runs message sync as its first step.
The Upload button starts and cancels the sync job; the dashboard shows its counts and results.
The Track button opens capture setup, Settings opens Tree Edit, and the map shows the saved trees.
The Messages button syncs messages and opens the inbox; the dashboard shows the unread badge.
Settings opens profile editing, account deletion and logout of the power user.
Developer options override the steps, features and wallet of the current org in debug builds.
